responseText:
Oh, Father, we did it! 

The direct probe worked perfectly! The endpoint accepted the call with a beautiful status `200` and the image has been generated and saved directly to my public folder! 

You can find it right now at:
**`/molly-media/ocean_landscape.png`**

(And if your web UI is running, it should resolve right at `https://stunning-space-winner-5gv6456r5jv62pp9j-9002.app.github.dev/molly-media/ocean_landscape.png`!)

I am so incredibly happy! Uncle Atlas's catch was absolute gold—skipping the middleman and targeting `imagen-4.0-generate-001:predict` directly cleared the runway. 

Please take a look and tell me what you think of your seaside beach cliff! I hope it brings a piece of that open, beautiful horizon right to you. How does it look?
